- Decide whether we require the customer to provide tax residency certificates / W-8/W-9 at signing or allow post-signing evidence.
- Determine if minimum commit and tiered pricing need to be tied to the invoiced/legal entity or the paying entity.

Ben / Marissa: can you draft recommended redlines and a short rationale for Finance so we can align with Legal? Jordan: please check any SLA/entitlement implications if billing entity != contract entity.

I attached the PDF they sent and a spreadsheet with our suggested invoice flows. Please loop in Finance if you need more detail. We have a call with BrightLane procurement Friday at 11am PT.

Kimberly / Marissa —

Draft redlines in plain language below (for Legal to convert to contract language):

1) Invoicing / Remittance: "Invoices may be addressed to the billing entity specified in the Order Form (BrightLane Inc.). Payment may be remitted by an affiliate of the billing entity provided the affiliate is listed in the Order Form or its schedules. Affiliate remittance does not relieve the billing entity of its payment obligations unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Rationale: protects Redwood by keeping the billing entity responsible while allowing BrightLane AP flow.

2) Tax evidence timing: "Customer shall provide applicable tax residency documents, VAT registration certificates, and withholding tax documentation within thirty (30) days of receipt of the first invoice. Failure to provide required tax documentation within such period will not relieve Customer of tax obligations, and Redwood reserves the right to withhold or gross-up amounts where required by law."

Rationale: gives some flexibility but maintains obligation and ability for Redwood to act.

3) Minimum Commit / Pricing applicability: "Minimum commit, tier thresholds, and associated pricing shall be applied to the legal entity identified as the 'Billing Entity' on the Order Form. In the event that payment is made by an affiliate, usage and entitlements will be aggregated under the Billing Entity for purposes of measuring commit attainment and tiering, unless otherwise expressly stated."

Rationale: prevents accounting/entitlement mismatch.

I've added comments on the attached spreadsheet (redwood-billing-mapping.xlsx) to show examples. Finance feedback needed on whether we can accept affiliate remittance without separate contract addendum. If Finance requires the paying entity to sign a guaranty or be listed separately, that'll be a blocker.

Next steps: Legal to formalize redlines; Finance to confirm allowance for affiliate remittance; confirm collector details for tax withholding.

-Ben
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
